subject: Evaluation top-up: bundle offer, SOW amendment & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@novagen.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novagen Procurement <procurement@novagen.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Eval top-up options and procurement path

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the support so far — the team has one ask before we wrap the time-boxed eval: can we get a 10–14 day runway top-up so we can finish a second integration and a perf sweep?

High level:
- Prefer a short extension (14 days) so we can keep the existing environment.
- If that's not doable, a bucket of 100k tokens we can draw against would also work.

Two procurement constraints on our side: our Legal team needs an amendment or SOW update (DocuSign is preferred), and Finance will want a PO before we accept any invoice.

Can you send options (pricing for 14-day extension vs token bucket, and any quick SOW language) and an estimate for how long Legal will need? We’re hoping to close this week.

Attaching: novagen-poc-summary.pdf (test artifacts).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alex
Alex Lopez
CTO, Novagen
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@novagen.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval top-up options and procurement path

Alex — thanks for the note and the summary. We can support both paths; three pragmatic options below so Procurement/Finance can pick the easiest route. I’ve attached a short offer doc with line items (redwood-eval-topup-options.pdf).

Option A — 14-day extension (recommended for minimal disruption)
- Price: 10% discount off retail rate for the 14-day window
- What’s included: same Dedicated trial environment, preserved KV caches, burst capacity for perf sweep
- Legal: quick amendment to existing SOW (1–2 pages)
- Docs: I can send the amendment for signature today if you confirm

Option B — 100k token bucket (pay-as-draw)
- Price: token bucket at a 12% effective discount vs PAYG list price (prepaid invoice)
- What’s included: token-only billing; no env changes required
- Legal: simple purchase order + invoice; no SOW change required for token bucket

Option C — Short-term hybrid (7 days + 50k token buffer)
- Price: blended discount (8%)

Next steps I suggest: you confirm preferred option and whether Novagen will provide a PO now or after amendment. If amendment, loop in the signer and I’ll send a DocuSign envelope.

Cc’ing Kimberly for legal/contract timeline and Ben for billing + finance contact.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval top-up options and procurement path

Hannah / Ben — quick internal note with what I’d suggest to move fast.

1) Pricing recommendation (we can be flexible to keep momentum):
- Approve Option A as presented but with a flat 10% concession off the short-term run rate. That’s within delegated authority.
- If Procurement prefers a token bucket, sign Option B at 12% discount, finance-friendly.

2) Legal / signature timeline:
- We’ll do a 1-page amendment referencing existing SOW and the extension dates; I’ll draft and upload to DocuSign.
- Expected turnaround: 2–3 business days once we have the signer’s name and email; if they need redlines, add 1–2 business days.

3) Invoicing and PO handling:
- If they can provide a PO referencing NVG-POC-4721 and request net-45, we can accept that (sales ops needs to flag billing in HubSpot).
- If Finance asks for Net-60, escalate to Sales Manager.

4) Attachments I’ll include in the envelope: redwood-amendment-draft.docx (amendment draft), and the short pricing sheet Hannah attached.

Action items:
- Hannah: confirm which option Alex prefers and whether they’ll issue a PO now.
- Ben: have Billing stand by for PO and invoice setup; ensure HubSpot record updated (link below).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/companies/7654321
DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.com/EnvelopeID/AB12CD34

Kimberly Park
Lead, Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@novagen.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novagen Procurement <procurement@novagen.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval top-up options and procurement path

Hannah / Kimberly — thanks, we’ll take Option A (14-day extension) and the 10% concession you outlined.

A few requests to finalize quickly:
- Procurement will issue a PO today referencing NVG-POC-4721 — I’ve attached the PO (novagen-po-4721.pdf).
- We prefer the amendment via DocuSign. Signer: Laura Kim (laura.kim@novagen.com). Please send to that email.
- Finance requests Net-45 on the invoice, which should be acceptable per Kimberly’s note.

If you can send the DocuSign envelope with the amendment and the invoice once the PO is received, we’ll sign and return promptly. Appreciate the fast help — Alex
